svg.title: Urolithin A: the randomized, placebo-controlled trials
svg.desc: Urolithin A: the randomized, placebo-controlled trials. Middle-aged adults, 2022, 88 people: Main goal missed; strength up. Maker-funded: Yes. Older adults, 2022, 66 people: Main goals missed; endurance up. Maker-funded: Yes. Immune aging, 2025, 50 people: Immune-cell shifts. Maker-funded: Yes. Adults with obesity, 2026, 50 people: Main goal missed. Maker-funded: No. Elite runners, 2025, 42 people: Race time not improved. Maker-funded: Yes. Strength athletes, 2024, 20 people: Some strength gains. Maker-funded: None reported. Heart failure, 2024, 10 people: No heart benefit. Maker-funded: Not stated.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
